decisions.decision: EnvironmentPreparation is a bounded semantic module, while EnvironmentVerificationGate remains Core-owned and is the sole readiness authority.
Readiness is evaluated against two profile layers: the DevRelay Windows Desktop host and one or more named project target profiles.
A deterministic native Windows inventory and verifier is the default implementation; inventory, acquisition, configuration, service-check, and target-probe adapters are optional capability bindings.
Preparation effects are project-local, reversible, idempotent, explicitly granted, fingerprinted before and after execution, and checkpointed for zero-effect replay.
Readiness binds the repository and approved upstream baselines to exact profiles, adapter and tool identities, and host and target fingerprints; drift creates a new immutable attempt.
Secrets remain opaque references with presence attestations, and network access is denied by default unless an exact destination and purpose grant is approved.
A trusted contributor derives forward-only traceability from verified readiness artifacts; adapters cannot mutate TraceabilityGraph or select relationship types.

approval.statement: I approve all EP-001 requirements and derived architecture decisions.
